network: live public Yahoo News, no archived fallback

observations.previous_1_0_383: All five items. The seventh rapid return lost the hero image and one headline; after scrolling, further headlines were missing. The row layout, thumbnails and some metadata remained. Fourteen of fifteen returns were unaffected.
observations.preview_fix_1_0_384: All five items. The eighth normal return lost the hero image and two headlines. One more real article was opened, then the list URL returned but almost all page text remained white for the full 20-second wait.

fresh_document_fix_1_0_385.review: The article itself and the correct Yahoo category were confirmed from pixels, including thumbnails, category labels and headlines. The hero-image color fraction relative to the pre-navigation reference ranged from 0.984 to 1.0.

scroll_position.first_capture_excluded: The first helper saw a matching article title at the restored list URL while the previous article raster was still visible. That capture and its 30-pixel delta are not counted.
scroll_position.independent_fresh_session: The same release APK and Google WebView version, BFCache confirmed enabled, on live Yahoo News. The scrolled list, the opened article, and the returned entertainment list were reviewed visually.

limitations: One Android emulator configuration with a software graphics stack. No physical Galaxy was tested. The evidence supports the rendering symptom and the scoped fresh-document mitigation; it does not identify a particular faulty line inside Chromium.
